# Decision register

**Generated by `scripts/build_decision_log.py` - do not edit by hand.**
Rerun it, or `--check` it, after answering anything on GitHub.

The reimplementation question bank is answered in GitHub issue comments.
This file is the derived, in-repo, `git`-diffable view of those answers, so
a plain clone can see what was decided without network access - the same
argument `snapshot` makes for keeping `CHANGELOG.md` alongside the GitHub
release notes.

Decisions deliberately do **not** live in `docs/drift-reports/drift-ledger.md`.
That ledger tracks divergence from canonical, its rows are numbered `D1..D14`,
and the question bank's backfill area is numbered `D-01..D-12` - one file
holding both would put `D8` and `D-08` in adjacent tables meaning unrelated
things.

**34 answered, 76 still open** across 15 areas.

in a requirement document. The requirement documents number their own
`E-`/`F-` requirements independently of the bank's areas E and F, so a
bare id in prose is ambiguous - say which namespace you mean.

## How a decision gets in here

Answer on the area issue, in one of the two shapes this script reads:

```markdown
## D-11 answered: append with `source_version`
**E-05 answered and built** - see #106.
```

On an older per-question issue whose *title* carries the id, a bare
`**Answered: ...**` is enough - the id comes from the title.

Every `[A-Z]-NN` id on that line is filed, so `## B-02 and B-03 answered by
#67` records both. Then rerun this script. An answer written in any other
shape will not appear - which is the point: the format is the rule.
